input: Call grandma for her birthday this Sunday

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing the exact time to call determines when to schedule the reminder — grandma's availability and time zone could shift the ideal call window significantly.
The method of contact (phone call, video call, voice message) changes what preparation or tools are needed.
A time zone difference between the user and grandma affects what 'Sunday morning' or 'afternoon' actually means for scheduling.
Knowing the intended call duration helps the user block out the right amount of time and not feel rushed.
Whether the user wants to prepare talking points, share a memory, or sing happy birthday changes what pre-call prep is needed.
Other family members joining or being mentioned in the call (e.g. coordinating a group call) adds coordination steps to the task.
Whether the user simply wants a reminder set, or wants a full plan with prep notes, defines what 'done' looks like for this task.

gold.taskTitle: Call grandma for her birthday this Sunday
gold.taskDescription: Make a birthday phone call to grandma this coming Sunday.

questions.title: What time of day do you plan to call her?
questions.description: Identifies the specific time window for the call so a reminder can be set accurately.

questions.title: Will this be a phone call or video call?
questions.description: Determines the communication tool or platform needed for the call.

questions.title: Are you in a different time zone from grandma?
questions.description: Ensures the scheduled call time works for both parties across any time zone gap.

questions.title: How long do you expect the call to last?
questions.description: Helps the user block out the right amount of time in their Sunday schedule.

questions.title: Do you want to prepare anything special to say or share?
questions.description: Determines whether pre-call prep steps (a story, a song, a memory) should be added to the plan.

questions.title: Will other family members be joining or coordinated into the call?
questions.description: Flags whether this is a solo call or requires coordinating a group call with other relatives.

questions.title: Do you just need a reminder, or a full prep checklist?
questions.description: Defines what a successful plan looks like — a simple alert vs. a structured set of preparation steps.
